tools.name: registrar_guidance
tools.description: Show model-facing operating guidance for mcp-registrar MCP workflows.

workflow.description: Optional workflow name or area to focus guidance on.

tool.description: Optional tool name for tool-specific guidance.

tools.name: registrar_surface_list
tools.description: List all known MCP surfaces with their packages, tools, and entrypoints.

tools.name: registrar_site_list
tools.description: List all known Narada sites with their root paths.

tools.name: registrar_site_surfaces
tools.description: Show which surfaces are bound to a site.

tools.name: registrar_site_bind
tools.description: Bind a surface to a Narada site MCP config. Creates or updates the site config file.

projection_id.description: Explicit surface projection identifier when the surface has more than one authority/runtime projection.

runtime_kind.description: Explicit selected runtime kind. Required when selecting a runtime-affined projection without naming projection_id.

allow_sidecar.description: Allow creating a compatibility sidecar even when an authoritative aggregate MCP fabric exists.

allow_disabled_sidecar.description: Allow binding a surface explicitly disabled by site override; intended only for compatibility repair.

tools.name: registrar_site_unbind
tools.description: Remove a surface from a Narada site MCP config.

tools.name: registrar_carrier_list
tools.description: List all known carriers with their config paths.

tools.name: registrar_carrier_bind
tools.description: Bind a surface to a carrier config (opencode, Kimi, or Codex).

projection_id.description: Explicit surface projection identifier when the surface has more than one authority/runtime projection.

site_id.description: Site context for arg interpolation, e.g. sonar. Defaults to andrey-user.

tools.name: registrar_carrier_unbind
tools.description: Remove a surface from a carrier config.

tools.name: registrar_sync
tools.description: Bind a surface to all sites/carriers, or bind all surfaces to carriers.

surface_id.description: Surface identifier. Required unless target is all_surfaces_to_carriers or all_surfaces_to_all_carriers.

projection_id.description: Explicit projection identifier for the selected surface.

runtime_kind.description: Explicit selected runtime kind for site materialization.

target.description: all_sites/all_carriers/all: bind one surface. all_surfaces_to_carriers: bind all surfaces to a specific carrier. all_surfaces_to_all_carriers: bind all surfaces to all carriers.

site_filter.description: Optional prefix filter for site IDs, e.g. narada-.

allow_sidecar.description: Allow explicit compatibility sidecar creation for sites with authoritative aggregate MCP fabric.

tools.name: registrar_carrier_validate
tools.description: Validate a carrier configuration without writing it: report missing entrypoints, duplicate server keys, missing required flags, and local/shared collisions.

tools.name: registrar_carrier_diff
tools.description: Compare the generated carrier config against the current carrier config file and report additions, removals, and changes.

tools.name: registrar_surface_usage
tools.description: Report which sites and carriers include a given MCP surface (shared surface id or site-local surface id ending in .local).

surface_id.description: Surface identifier, e.g. site-inbox, local-filesystem, or inbox-mcp.local.

tools.name: registrar_site_mcp_fabric_validate
tools.description: Validate a site-local MCP fabric (.ai/mcp/*.json): entrypoints exist, required flags present, duplicate server keys.

tools.name: registrar_site_surface_registry_sync
tools.description: Regenerate a site action-admission MCP surface registry from the site MCP fabric and registrar surface catalog.

dry_run.description: Return the generated registry without writing it.

tools.name: registrar_surface_tool_inventory_check
tools.description: Compare registrar surface tool metadata with observed MCP tools/list names and report per-surface drift.

observed_tools.description: Map of surface id to observed tools/list names.

include_ok.description: Include passing surfaces in the output.

tools.name: registrar_site_registry_conformance_check
tools.description: Prove materialized site MCP registry conformance from an immutable Loader observation ref across live tools/list, site fabric, registrar catalog, and admission classification.

observation_ref.description: Immutable mcp_payload ref returned by mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check for this Site.

tools.name: registrar_site_output_reader_closure_check
tools.description: Check materialized site MCP surface registries for output-ref producer tools whose required reader tools are missing from live or read-only admission metadata.

site_id.description: Single known site identifier to inspect.

site_root.description: Single explicit site root to inspect.

include_ok.description: Include passing site summaries in output.

guidance.purpose: MCP surface registrar for site/carrier binding and materialized Site registry conformance.
first_use: Validate the Site fabric with registrar_site_mcp_fabric_validate before regenerating its materialized registry.
Use mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check to obtain an immutable observation_ref from actual child tools/list responses.
Pass observation_ref unchanged to registrar_site_registry_conformance_check; the Registrar resolves it against the target Site root.
Preserve structuredContent as authoritative evidence; text content is for assistant readability.

tool_preference.guidance: Call registrar_site_mcp_fabric_validate for the target Site.
Call mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check against the same Site root. Every live tool must explicitly declare readOnlyHint=true or false.
Run pnpm materialize:carrier from the mcp-surfaces workspace. The installed native materializer is the sole carrier-config authority.
Call registrar_site_surface_registry_sync only when the Site fabric and catalog are intentional.
Call registrar_site_registry_conformance_check with the Loader observation_ref. Status ok is the authority projection proof.
Repair drift at its owning layer: surface annotations, Site fabric, registrar catalog, or materialized registry generation.

anti_patterns: Do not infer mutation semantics from tool names. The live surface must declare readOnlyHint explicitly.
Do not treat a tools/list name match as full conformance; classification, provenance, partition, projection, and output-reader closure must also pass.
Do not copy or hand-build observation maps; pass the immutable Loader observation_ref.
Do not regenerate a registry to conceal drift in a surface annotation or Site fabric declaration.
Do not bypass the owning surface with shell scripts when a governed MCP tool exists.

Do not edit a carrier config paired with .narada-generation.json. Use mcp-loader for progressive attachment or Registrar binding tools for an intentional static binding; direct edits invalidate the shared carrier generation.
recovery: For unknown_tool, call tools/list and this guidance command again after restart.
For missing live observations, rerun mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check and pass its new observation_ref.
For live_tool_semantics_partition_incomplete, add an explicit boolean readOnlyHint at the owning surface; do not default it.
For registry drift, repair the named layer and then rematerialize and rerun the full proof.

If mcp-registrar itself cannot start because carrier materialization is stale, use the direct native bootstrap recovery (not an MCP call): run pnpm materialize:carrier from the mcp-surfaces workspace. It invokes the installed immutable Rust authority without building the JavaScript workspace; restart affected carrier sessions afterward.
Canonical native recovery always rematerializes the complete declared carrier set transactionally. It has no single-carrier escape hatch.
For unclear behavior, submit surface_feedback_submit with reproduction steps, expected behavior, and impact.

when: guidance is missing, stale, or contradicted by live behavior
schema shape makes correct usage hard
errors hide the actionable refusal or recovery path

boundaries: The registrar materializes and verifies authority declarations; it does not infer policy from names.
MCP Loader owns fresh child attachment and live tools/list observation.
Observation created_by and payload-id checks are declarative lineage guards, not cryptographic provenance or authority.
Each owning MCP surface remains authoritative for execution policy and domain enforcement.
